1479-5621-8338.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Shuttlecraft Galileo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3490-6723-7075-8296.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6723-7075-8296.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2577-5670-7918.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-7918.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

549-5256-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-5256-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Altar of Dementia.

643-3413-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Maskwood Nexus, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1339-2034-2122-7803.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2122-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1339-2034-2122-7803.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

670-1619-4865-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4865-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Auton Soldier each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4865-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Birgi and Medusa trigger.

Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.

Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Doc Samson.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
4968-6919-7704.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat.

856-2099-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus

Repeat from step 1.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2653-2893-5455-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3499-4871-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.

Cast Outrider en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Sage of the Beyond.
Repeat.

1669-2511-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-2511-3234-3293.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat
1669-2511-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1558-4840-6911.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block Myr Battlesphere.
1558-4840-6911.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Myr Battlesphere, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere.
When the Myr Battlesphere token enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the four Myr tokens and sacrificing the Myr Battlesphere token, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

Play Golgari Rot Farm.

Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Seed the Land trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2816-5457.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three creatures with different powers.
2816-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Selvala by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and acrificing God-Eternal Rhonas.
When God-Eternal Rhonas dies, its second ability and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the God-Eternal Rhonas trigger, putting it into your library from your graveyard third from the top.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for God-Eternal Rhonas and putting it onto the battlefield.
When God-Eternal Rhonas enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the God-Eternal Rhonas trigger, doubling the power and toughness of creatures you control until end of turn.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Triskelavus.

When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.

Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may instead use the Triskelavite token's ability to sacrifice it, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).

Resolve the copy of Channel the Suns, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain 7 life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Personal Tutor by paying {U}, searching your library for Approach of the Second Sun and putting it on top of your library.
Draw Approach of the Second Sun from your library.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.

When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {1}.
Cast Kediss by paying {1}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
When Kediss enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Throne of Geth trigger, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clue and The Hollow Sentinel, untapping Throne of Geth.
Repeat.

Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

570-2024-2251.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-2024-2251.description:

Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Faeburrow Elder +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
